offer.text: There is a fire drake in the hills and I will not pretend this is a fair request. One of them. Bring me back something that proves it.

accept.text: Take a shield you do not mind losing.

decline.text: Sensible. Nobody has ever called that sensible before.

in_progress.text: It is still up there. I can see the smoke from the yard.

ready.text: You did it. You actually did it.

complete.text: I will forge something out of this that outlasts the both of us.
